newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates end steady at 20.00 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates end steady at 20.00 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates closed unchanged at 20.00 percent on Monday, traders said.
Overnight rates traded between 20.25 and 19.625 percent compared with Friday's close of 20.00 percent and the majority of the deals were struck at 20.00 percent, they added.
Just before the market closed, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) cut two of its five repo rates by 25 basis points each with immediate effect.
The one-week reverse repo facility was set at 20.00 percent while the one-month reverse repo at 20.50 percent, both down 0.25 percent.
Market participants said that despite general expectations of the move, the timing of the cut was surprising as it happened during business.
